title: A shortage requires production and consumption evidence

applicability.game_version: Observed in RimWorld 1.6; revalidate behavior for the current game.
applicability.mods: RimMolt and ordinary gameplay; details can vary by version and other enabled mods.

observed: Low stock persisted alongside production orders and unfinished sites.
explanation: The cause can be inputs, labor, access, consumption or materials already committed; stock alone is insufficient.
recommendation: Inspect the production chain and compare output with consumption before repeating orders.
exceptions: An urgent shortfall may require immediate hunting/trade or triage while investigation continues.
verify: Observe completed output, available work, required inputs, storage/spoilage and committed materials.
review: Reviewed source account; retain provisional status and avoid universal tactical claims.
